english.note: Use this for someone in the same room when the shared-room setting is clear, such as a dormitory or hospital ward.

examples.english: When I was in the hospital, my roommate was very easy to talk to.
examples.traditional: 我入院嗰陣，同房係個好好傾嘅人。
